letterboxd-review-1539532132.title: Amores Perros
letterboxd-review-1539532132.review: emotionally exhausting movie but i’m quite in awe of its technical achievement. thematically, such an interesting case study in how love, loyalty, and survival can quickly become entangled with cruelty and selfishness. i love the violence of this film. its relentless and alive and, in an oddly cool way, used to explore contradictions in human nature. and there’s a very distinct technical style here that works perfectly with the films themes. it shows how brutality and vulnerability often exist side by side, made more meaningful though this films choice of fragmented, intersecting narratives, incredibly personal and in your face handheld camerawork, and gritty, kinetic editing. these technical choices are almost inseparable from its thematic ideas, with both its visual and narrative brutality mirroring a world where humanity and cruelty coexist. dreadful stuff.
